title: 第17章 诡异症状第18章 灵石到手
content_zh:
沈凝霜坐在茶桌上喝茶，然而心思却不在茶桌上。
面容精致绝美，但面纱下升起一抹犹豫。
“算了，答应了那个老家伙要护在他身边三年。”
突然沈凝霜心头一动，似乎是想起了什么。
声音清脆而冷淡，如同冰山雪莲一般：“今天是什么日子？”
王大海本以为是听错了，结果还真的是沈凝霜开口问他。
“沈姑娘，今天是天元历正月初五。”
坏了。
沈凝霜听后直接瞬移消失在原地，化作一抹白色流光。
“咕噜！”
这把王大海看的人都傻掉了。
“叶兄这是交了一个什么恐怖的朋友？”
而此时叶祈安几人才刚刚踏进凶兽山脉外围。
这一刻，叶祈安心中隐隐有种不祥的预感。
但愿是自己多虑了。
叶祈安看着一望无际的外围山脉，周围湿度比上次来的时候重了许多。
周围还传出瘆人的嘘声，让人头皮发麻。
一个胆子有点小的女弟子连忙拉着苏也的衣角。
“有点不对劲，大家小心点，提高警惕。”叶祈安脸色凝重的说道。
“好。”

由于叶祈安有过经验，所以站在队伍中的第一位，苏也垫后，绫轻烟在叶祈安后面。
殊不知在一棵参天大树的树冠上方，正有一头瞳孔冒着红光的凶兽正死死的盯着几人。
獠牙长达三十多公分，隐隐有粘稠的液体滴下，它舔了舔舌头，表现的很饥饿的样子。
不过它似乎是看出了这些人类修士的强大，并没有轻举妄动。
只不过它的全身无时无刻都开始散发出一股无色无味的气体。
正在逐渐的蔓延附近外围山脉。
而此时的一行人还浑然不知道危险的到来。
叶祈安打开地图，沉声说道。
“距离三阶初期凶兽天狮鹫的领地还剩下不足五公里了，大家小心。”
有一点叶祈安感觉到很奇怪。
“上次还没进入到这么深，就频繁遇到低阶的凶兽袭击，这次深入反而一路上都没有遇到袭击。”
“难道是上次运气太差？”
“你们有没有发现咱们这一路走来都太顺利了？”
“这可不像是危机重重的凶兽山脉。”
绫轻烟也是发现了这个问题。
content_en:
Shen Ningshuang was sitting on the tea table drinking tea, but her mind was not on the tea table.
The face is delicate and beautiful, but there is a hint of hesitation under the veil.
"Forget it, I promised that old guy to stay by his side for three years."
Suddenly, Shen Ningshuang's heart moved, as if she remembered something.
The voice was crisp and cold, like an iceberg and a snow lotus: "What day is today?"
Wang Dahai thought he heard wrongly, but it turned out that Shen Ningshuang really asked him.
"Miss Shen, today is the fifth day of the first lunar month in the Tianyuan calendar."
Broken.
After hearing this, Shen Ningshuang teleported and disappeared in place, turning into a white stream of light.
"Gulu!"
Everyone who looked at Wang Dahai was dumbfounded.
"Brother Ye, what kind of horrible friend has he made?"
At this time, Ye Qian and the others had just stepped into the outskirts of the Fierce Beast Mountain Range.
At this moment, Ye Qian had a vague premonition in his heart.
I hope I am worrying too much.
Ye Qian looked at the endless surrounding mountains. The surrounding humidity was much heavier than the last time he came here.
There were also horrifying boos coming from all around, making people's scalp numb.
A timid female disciple quickly grabbed Su Ye's clothes.
"Something is wrong. Please be careful and be vigilant." Ye Qian said with a solemn expression.
"Okay."
Since Ye Qian'an had experience, he stood first in the team, with Su Ye behind and Ling Qingyan behind Ye Qian'an.
Little did they know that above the crown of a towering tree, there was a ferocious beast with glowing red pupils staring at the group of people.
The fangs were more than thirty centimeters long, and there was faint viscous liquid dripping from them. It licked its tongue and looked very hungry.
However, it seemed to see the power of these human monks and did not act rashly.
But its whole body began to emit a colorless and odorless gas all the time.
It is gradually spreading to the nearby outer mountains.
At this time, the group of people still had no idea that the danger was coming.
Ye Qian opened the map and said in a deep voice.
"There are less than five kilometers left to the territory of the early stage third-level ferocious beast Celestial Griffin. Everyone, be careful."
Ye Qian felt something strange.
"Last time we didn't go so deep, we were frequently attacked by low-level ferocious beasts. This time we went deeper, but we didn't encounter any attacks along the way."
"Did you have bad luck last time?"
"Have you noticed that our journey has been too smooth?"
"This is not like a dangerous beast mountain range."
Ling Qingyan also discovered this problem.
